rulings: R75 (2026-09-19, Drew): 2026 Bowman Mega Box (bowman-mega) and 2026 Bowman Chrome Mega Box (bowman-chrome-mega-box) are TWO products, same numbers, different players. PR #2319 committed the two corrected rosters and already ingested the 268-row plain-Mega-Box base/insert package under bowman-mega (beckett-s3-2026-09-19).

ORCHESTRATOR RULING 2026-09-19: do NOT delete/retire the 4,825 crossed bowman-chrome-mega-box rows. They are the plain Mega Box's checklistinsider/beckett/hobbymonitor parallel + insert ladder, filed under the wrong product id; the 268-row corrected Chrome package has no rungs of its own yet, so deleting them would lose the ladder entirely. They must be MOVED (reslug: id product segment AND setKey field both become bowman-mega), never retired/parked.

moveCatalogRow's changedFields.setKey (built by relocate-catalog-rows-by-list.cjs's crossProductFields, since destination stem 'bowman-mega' differs from source stem 'bowman-chrome-mega-box') is spread onto the stored row in buildIncoming (catalogRowOps.service.ts:511) -- confirmed by reading the code: a cross-product reslug rewrites the setKey FIELD, not just the id segment.

HELD OUT (not in `entries`, not target-exists -- excluded categorically, same policy as the companion sales list): BCP-151 (the exact boundary card between the two rosters' own BCP numbering) and the three shared-player numbers #17/CRA-BE/CRA-RA where roster identity can never disambiguate. None of CRA-BE/CRA-RA appeared in the crossed catalog bucket in this census; BCP-151 and #17 did and are held out below.

target-exists: destinations already occupied by one of the 268 rows PR #2319 already ingested under bowman-mega. Per relocate-catalog-rows-by-list's own occupancy guard (occupiedByDifferentCard / occupancyRefusal), a curated list naming an occupied destination is refused rather than merged when the two rows are different cards, and reported for the owner to reconcile by hand -- NOT auto-resolved here, and NOT included in `entries`.

Order of operations: (1) apply the companion sales list 2026-09-19-r75-bowman-mega-box-uncross-sales.json FIRST (repoints/relocates sales onto the bowman-mega/bowman-chrome-mega-box addresses this reslug will make correct); (2) apply THIS catalog reslug list; (3) ingest the corrected Chrome Mega Box checklist package (acq-2026-09-19-beckett-bowman-chrome-mega-box-2026) into the now-freed bowman-chrome-mega-box ids -- freed because this reslug vacates them, so the incoming checklist row will not tie against a same-authority incumbent (mergeCatalogEntries: !existing -> winnerIsIncoming unconditionally).

The 289 chrome-id catalog rows under GPK/BWC/FD/BS insert prefixes (neither roster's committed CSV lists these numbers at all) are LEFT UNTOUCHED by this list -- out of scope of R75's two files, a separate gap for the owner to investigate.
